headline: Antonelli wins the Spanish Grand Prix
standfirst: Kimi Antonelli won the Spanish Grand Prix for Mercedes, finishing 4.351s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Lando Norris completing the podium after 57 laps of Madring.

sections.title: The start
sections.body: Lando Norris lined up first on the grid. Norris converted that into the lead at the end of lap one. The biggest winner of the opening lap was Colapinto, up 2 places to 7th.

sections.title: How it unfolded
sections.body: The lead changed hands 2 times. Laps led: Leclerc (32), Norris (15) and Antonelli (10). Antonelli took the lead for good on lap 48. The race ran green from start to finish.

sections.title: Strategy
sections.body: Antonelli made 1 stop, running medium → hard tyres. The field made 25 pit stops in total; the quickest stationary time was 2.2s for Russell on lap 28. 9 of the top 10 finishers got home with one stop or fewer.

sections.title: Movers
sections.body: Oliver Bearman made up the most ground, climbing 6 places from 22nd to 16th. Timing recorded 123 on-track position changes, 9 of them by Gasly.

sections.title: Retirements
sections.body: Perez (lap 32), Stroll (lap 13), Hamilton (lap 7) and Sainz (lap 44) failed to finish.

sections.title: Conditions and pace
sections.body: It stayed dry throughout. Track temperature ranged from 53°C to 55°C, with air at 30–32°C. George Russell set the fastest lap, a 1:35.587 on lap 49.
